PROCEDURE fetch_component_details IS

BEGIN

 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date)

 (system_label_decision is null and
 relabel_product_code is null and

--message( :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id||' '||:ctrl_blk_1.product_code||' '||:s_chapter_id||' '||to_char(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,'DD-MON-YYYY'));pause;

ProgramUnit.Name: DEL_COMPONENT_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- Added by Kishore on 08/28/2012. SCR 18012
PROCEDURE DEL_COMPONENT_CHECK IS
 t_component_status components.component_status%type;
 t_stock_state shipped_products.stock_state%type;
 t_label_user_id components.label_user_id%type;
 t_label_dats components.label_dats%type;
 t_system_label_decision components.system_label_decision%type;
 t_dummy varchar2(1);
 t_product_status pick_slip_products.product_status%type;
 err_txt varchar2(200); 
 al_id alert;
 al_button number;
BEGIN
 --message('Test'); pause;
 al_id := find_alert('AL_DEL_COMPONENT');
 
 begin
 select component_status, label_user_id, 
 label_dats, system_label_decision
 into t_component_status, t_label_user_id, 
 t_label_dats, t_system_label_decision
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 and product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 and component_prefix = :ctrl_blk_1.component_prefix
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_component_status := null;
 t_label_user_id := null;
 t_label_dats := null;
 t_system_label_decision := null;
 when others then
 t_component_status := null;
 t_label_user_id := null;
 t_label_dats := null;
 t_system_label_decision := null;
 end;
 --message('Component Status: ' || t_component_status); pause;
 
 begin
 select product_status
 into t_product_status
 from pick_slip_products
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 and product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_product_status := null;
 when others then
 t_product_status := null;
 end;
 --message('Product Status: ' || t_product_status); pause;
 
 if nvl(t_component_status, '*') = 'S' then
 begin
 select stock_state
 into t_stock_state
 from shipped_products
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 and product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_stock_state := null;
 when others then
 t_stock_state := null;
 end;
 
 if nvl(t_stock_state, '*') = 'SH' then -- Check if the product has been shipped - not in custody of lab or distribution 
 show_error('2516');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif nvl(t_stock_state, '*') = 'RT' then -- Check if the product has been shipped and returned to shipping custody 
 show_error('2517');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif nvl(t_product_status, '*') = 'PK' then -- Check if the product has been packed
 show_error('2519');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('2518');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 elsif nvl(t_component_status, '*') = 'L' then
 --message('Test1'); pause;
 begin
 select 'x'
 into t_dummy
 from return_items
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 and product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_dummy := null;
 when others then
 t_dummy := null;
 end;
 --message('Dummy: ' || t_dummy); pause;
 
 if nvl(t_product_status, '*') = 'RT' and t_dummy is not null then -- Check if the product has been shipped and returned
 show_error('2520');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif t_label_user_id is not null and 
 t_label_dats is not null and 
 t_system_label_decision is not null then -- Check if the product has been labeled 
 begin
 select error
 into err_txt
 from valid_errors_lab
 where error_code = '2521';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 err_txt := null;
 when others then
 err_txt := null;
 end;
 
 set_alert_property(al_id, alert_message_text, err_txt); 
 al_button := show_alert(al_id);
 else
 begin
 select error
 into err_txt
 from valid_errors_lab
 where error_code = '2522';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 err_txt := null;
 when others then
 err_txt := null;
 end;
 
 set_alert_property(al_id, alert_message_text, err_txt); 
 al_button := show_alert(al_id);
